## Team Directory

This page provides an overview of our PMX (Performance Metrics Excellence) team members. Our diverse team brings together expertise in data science, analytics, and domain-specific knowledge to deliver exceptional insights and solutions.

View the interactive directory below to explore team member information, roles, and key performance indicators.

## Team Members

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

set.seed(123)

# Create sample people data
people_data <- data.frame(
  Name = c("Sarah Johnson", "Michael Chen", "Emily Rodriguez", "David Kim",
           "Jessica Martinez", "Robert Taylor", "Amanda Wilson", "James Brown",
           "Maria Garcia", "Christopher Lee", "Nicole Anderson", "Daniel White"),
  Department = c("Analytics", "Data Science", "Analytics", "Engineering",
                 "Data Science", "Analytics", "Engineering", "Data Science",
                 "Analytics", "Engineering", "Data Science", "Analytics"),
  Role = c("Senior Analyst", "Data Scientist", "Analyst", "Data Engineer",
           "ML Engineer", "Team Lead", "Senior Engineer", "Data Scientist",
           "Analyst", "Data Engineer", "Data Scientist", "Senior Analyst"),
  Years_Experience = c(7, 5, 3, 6, 4, 10, 8, 5, 2, 7, 6, 9),
  Projects_Completed = c(34, 28, 15, 42, 19, 67, 53, 31, 12, 45, 29, 58),
  Active_Projects = c(3, 4, 2, 5, 3, 2, 4, 3, 3, 4, 4, 3)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Avg_Projects_Per_Year = round(Projects_Completed / Years_Experience, 1),
    Utilization = round((Active_Projects / 5) * 100, 0),
    Status = ifelse(Active_Projects >= 4, "High Load",
                    ifelse(Active_Projects >= 2, "Normal", "Available"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Department, desc(Years_Experience))

# Create interactive table
datatable(people_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 12,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE,
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf')
          ),
          filter = 'top',
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = "PMX Team Directory") %>%
  formatStyle('Status',
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(
                c('High Load', 'Normal', 'Available'),
                c('#fff3cd', '#d1ecf1', '#d4edda')
              )) %>%
  formatStyle('Utilization',
              background = styleColorBar(c(0, 100), '#4b7874'),
              backgroundSize = '95% 75%',
              backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat',
              backgroundPosition = 'center')
```
